name: ramkin-coffee
description: RAMKIN Coffee digital loyalty & rewards platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ramkin/shared && npm run build -w @ramkin/customer && npm run build -w @ramkin/admin && npm run build -w @ramkin/functions
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @ramkin/shared && npm run build -w @ramkin/customer && npm run build -w @ramkin/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ramkin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ramkin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ramkin/customer && npm run typecheck -w @ramkin/admin && npm run typecheck -w @ramkin/functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ramkin/shared && npm run test -w @ramkin/customer && npm run test -w @ramkin/admin && npm run test -w @ramkin/functions
